def VTask.strongDownwardInduction : {α : Type u_1} -> {p : Finset α → Sort u_4} -> {n : ℕ} -> (H : (t₁ : Finset α) → ({t₂ : Finset α} → t₂.card ≤ n → t₁ ⊂ t₂ → p t₂) → t₁.card ≤ n → p t₁) -> (s : Finset α) -> s.card ≤ n → p s :=
  fun {α} {p} {n} H s hs =>
    let h : ∀ (s : Finset α), s.card ≤ n → p s := by
      intro s
      induction' s using Finset.induction_on with a s has ih
      intro hsc
      have h₁ : s.card ≤ n := by
        have h₂ : s.card ≤ (insert a s).card := by
          apply Finset.card_mono
          apply Finset.subset_insert
        have h₃ : (insert a s).card ≤ n := by simpa [has] using hsc
        linarith
      -- We use the given step function H to construct the value for s.card ≤ n
      have h₂ : p s := H s (fun {t₂} ht₂ hss => ih t₂ ht₂ (by
        -- Prove that s is a subset of t₂
        have h₃ : s ⊆ t₂ := by
          have h₄ : s ⊆ insert a s := Finset.subset_insert a s
          have h₅ : insert a s ⊆ t₂ := by
            have h₆ : insert a s ⊂ t₂ := by
              simpa [has] using hss
            exact Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mp h₆ |>.1
          exact Finset.Subset.trans h₄ h₅
        -- Since s is a subset of t₂, we can use the induction hypothesis
        have h₇ : t₂.card ≤ n := ht₂
        have h₈ : s.card ≤ t₂.card := Finset.card_le_of_subset h₃
        linarith
      )) h₁
      exact h₂
    h s hs
